configuration.sampling_measure: rotationally invariant Haar measure on S^5 via normalized complex Gaussian vectors generated by scrambled Sobol points

interpretation: The complex three-family orientation at fixed portal norm is now sampled with an explicit rotationally invariant geometric measure. The resulting excluded fraction describes only that chosen orientation measure with all other portal magnitudes and matching assumptions fixed. It is not a UV probability or posterior and cannot establish whole-model exclusion.
